term: matched observable response with distinct hidden causal records
definition: Two stipulated Exercises on the same Boolean-pair scenario space have matching occurrence truth tables for the two public contributors and their effect, under the explicit correspondence single.a ↔ plural.0, single.b ↔ plural.1 and single.t ↔ plural.2. The models have different event and bearer carriers and separate record graphs; hidden events are not identified by this observation interface.
note: Observable equality is neither equality of complete event structures nor causal or interventional equivalence. In the completed single-source control, root occurrence is true exactly when both inputs are true; the #735 plural control has no such common root. Both satisfy every recorded group's scenario-wide sufficiency and inductive Supply. Neither scenario sufficiency nor Supply establishes productive explanation. See docs/notes/joint-cooperation-744.md.
